# Auto Import

Target: ~100 cases.
Subcategories: Named imports 15, Default imports 10, Namespace imports 5, Relative paths 10, Absolute paths/aliases 10, Directory index 10, Multiple matching exports 10, Duplicate import prevention 5, Existing import merging 10, Unused/unavailable exports 5, Monorepo/package imports 5, Extension resolution 5.

Status: 0 cases implemented (autocomplete/object-properties.test.ts is the pattern example, counted under autocomplete).


One folder per subcategory (<subcategory>/), one file per case: <subcategory>/<case>.test.ts, e.g. variable/const-number-autocomplete.test.ts.
